name: AgentWallet MCP Server
description: Provides permissionless wallet infrastructure for AI agents to manage wallets, sign transactions, and handle tokens across Solana and all EVM-compatible chains. It includes 29 specialized tools for on-chain operations, featuring built-in security guards and automated x402 payment processing without KYC requirements.
